translation.name: Luda yã takada kũ Bisã yão

content: Yenibɑn biru, Yosɑfɑti u kpunɑ u gu. Mɑ bɑ nùn sikɑ win bɑɑbɑbɑn sikɑɔ, Dɑfidin wuuɔ. Mɑ win bii Yorɑmu u bɑndu kɔsire kuɑ.
Yorɑmu u bɑndu di
Yorɑmu u wɔnɔbu mɔwɑ nɔɔbɑ tiɑ. Be kpuro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Yosɑfɑtin bibu. Berɑ Asɑriɑ kɑ Yeyɛli kɑ Sɑkɑri kɑ Asɑriɑ kɑ Mikɑɛli kɑ Sefɑtiɑ.
Ben tundo u ben bɑɑwure kɛ̃ru wɛ̃ tɑ kpɑ̃. Terɑ sii geesu kɑ wurɑ kɑ gɑ̃ɑ gobiginu kɑ wuu si su gbɑ̃rɑnu mɔ Yudɑn temɔ. Adɑmɑ Yorɑmuwɑ u bɑndu wɛ̃ domi wiyɑ u sɑ̃ɑ win bii gbiikoo.
Sɑnɑm mɛ Yorɑmu u bɑn te di u kpɑ, mɑ u tu tɑ̃sisiɑ, yerɑ u win wɔnɔ be kpuro kɑ Isirelibɑn bukurobu gɑbu go.
Sɑnɑm mɛ Yorɑmu u bɑn te di, u mɔwɑ wɔ̃ɔ tɛnɑ kɑ yiru. Mɑ u kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ itɑ bɑndu sɔɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
Isirelibɑn sinɑmbun yirɑ u swĩi nge mɛ Akɑbun yɛnugibu bɑ kuɑ. Domi Akɑbun bii tɔn kurɔwɑ u suɑ kurɔ. Kɔ̃sɑ u kuɑ Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ.
Adɑmɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u ǹ wure u nùn go, ɑrukɑwɑni ye u kɑ Dɑfidi bɔkuɑn sɔ̃ ye u nɛɛ, Dɑfidi kun kɔsire biɑmɔ bɑndu sɔɔ win bweserɔ.
Yorɑmun wɑɑti ye sɔɔ, Edɔmubɑ bɑ kɑ tii yinɑ, mɑ bɑ ben sunɔ kuɑ.
Yerɑ Yorɑmu u seewɑ kɑ win tɑbu sinɑmbu kɑ tɑbu kɛkɛ yi dumi gɑwe, mɑ bɑ bu tɑrusi. Adɑmɑ, ye n kuɑ wɔ̃kuru, mɑ bɑ duki yɑkurɑ.
Sɑɑ yen dɔmɑ ten diyɑ Edɔmubɑ bɑ kɑ tii yinɛ sere kɑ gisɔn gisɔ. Mɑ Libinɑgibu bɑ mɑɑ Yudɑbɑ seesi yèn sɔ̃ bɑ Gusunɔ ben bɑɑbɑbɑn Yinni deri.
Yorɑmu u mɑm bũu yɑ̃ku yenu kuɑ Yudɑbɑn guunu wɔllɔ. Mɑ u derɑ bɑ bũu gɑsirinu wɔri. U bu bɔriewɑ ni sɔɔ mɑm mɑm.
Yerɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Eli u nùn yoruɑ u nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ Gusunɔ wunɛn bɑɑbɑ Dɑfidin Yinni u geruɑ. U nɛɛ, wee, ɑ ǹ sĩɑ wunɛn bɑɑbɑbɑ Yosɑfɑti kɑ Asɑ, Yudɑbɑn sinɑmbun yirɑ sɔɔ.

Isirelibɑn sinɑmbun yirɑ sɔɔrɑ ɑ sĩɑ. Mɑ ɑ derɑ Yudɑbɑ kɑ Yerusɑlɛmugibu kpuro bɑ bũu gɑsirinu wɔri nge mɛ Akɑbun yɛnugibu bɑ derɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ kuɑ. Yen biru, ɑ mɑɑ wunɛn wɔnɔbu mwɛɛrɑ ɑ go, be, be bɑ nun sɑnɔ kere wunɛn tundon yɛnuɔ.
Yen sɔ̃, Yinni Gusunɔ u koo wunɛn tɔmbu wɑhɑlɑ bɑkɑ doke, kɑ wunɛn kurɔbu kɑ wunɛn bibu kɑ sere mɑɑ bɛɛn ɑrumɑni ye i mɔ.
Kpɑ u wunɛn tii bɑrɑ bɑkɑru kpɛ̃ɛ nuki sɔɔ. Kpɑ tɑ n kpɛ̃ɑmɔ tɔ̃ɔ bɑɑtere sere tu kɑ wunɛn nuki yɑrɑmɑ tɔɔwɔ.
Yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Filisitibɑ seeyɑ kɑ Dɑɑrububɑ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Kusigibun bɔkuɔ. Mɑ bɑ Yorɑmu wɔri.
Yerɑ bɑ Yudɑbɑ wɔri bɑ ben dukiɑbɑ mwɛɛrɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ sinɑ bokon yɛnuɔ kɑ mɑɑ win bibu kɑ win kurɔbu bɑ kɑ doonɑ. Win bii dɑ̃ɑko Akɑsiɑwɑ bɑ deri, wi bɑ mɑɑ mɔ̀ Yoɑkɑsi.
Yenibɑn biru, Yinni Gusunɔ u sinɑ bokon tii bɑrɑru kpɛ̃ɛ nukurɔ te u ǹ bɛkurɑmɔ.
Mɑ win bɑrɑ te, tɑ sosimɔ tɔ̃ɔ bɑɑtere. Bɑrɑ ten wɔ̃ɔ yiruse sɔɔrɑ win nuki yɑrimɑ ten wɑhɑlɑn sɔ̃. Mɑ u gu nɔni swɑ̃ɑ bɑkɑru sɔɔ. Win tɔmbu bɑ ǹ nùn turɑre dɔ̃ɔ dokeye nge mɛ u win bɑɑbɑbɑ kuɑ.
Yorɑmu u mɔwɑ wɔ̃ɔ tɛnɑ kɑ yiru sɑnɑm mɛ u bɑndu di. Mɑ u kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ itɑ bɑndu sɔɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Ye u gu, goo kun nùn wɔnwɔndu kue. Mɑ bɑ nùn sikuɑ Dɑfidin wuuɔ. Adɑmɑ n ǹ mɔ sinɑmbun sikɑɔ.
Akɑsiɑ u bɑndu di Yudɑɔ
